sub_answers.sub_question: What documented financial difficulties, sponsorship withdrawals, or insolvency events has the club experienced and when?
sub_answers.text: CFR Cluj experienced serious financial difficulties after 2012 that culminated in insolvency during the 2014–15 season and non-payment of former players, which led the Romanian Football Federation to deduct 24 points before those points were later restored by the Court of Arbitration for Sport in May 2015 [d2376249s5p0]. Kagua-Erave FC had reports in early May 2019 that players had not been paid, which temporarily threw the club’s participation in the 2019 National Soccer League playoffs into doubt before they ultimately played their quarter-final match on 11 May 2019 [d60559687s1p0] [d60559687s0p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What disputes, sanctions, or controversies involving club officials, players, or administrators have been publicly reported?
sub_answers.text: CFR Cluj’s owner, Pászkány, faced legal charges and was reported to have neglected the team during the post-2012 decline [d2376249s5p0]. The Romanian Football Federation sanctioned CFR Cluj by deducting 24 points for failing to fully remunerate five former players, a sanction the club successfully appealed to the Court of Arbitration for Sport [d2376249s5p0]. Kagua-Erave FC faced a public labour-related issue in 2019 when it was reported that players had not been paid ahead of the playoffs [d60559687s1p0].

sub_answers.text: In 1990 Odense Kammeraternes Sportsklub experienced financial trouble following relegation from the second level of Danish football [d67182214s2p0]. The club's financial problems were partly caused by an unmet financial guarantee in star player Allan Hansen's contract [d67182214s2p0]. The club's situation worsened after its main sponsors withdrew their financial support [d67182214s2p0]. The club managed to establish an agreement with its creditors which kept the club afloat financially [d67182214s2p0]. The club had previously secured a capital injection from local sponsor Bendix Capital during its 1980s success period [d67182214s2p0].
